title: Mid- and Long-term Outcomes of Custom-made Aortic Devices
official: Results From a Multicenter Registry on the Outcomes of the Terumo Custom-made Aortic Endograft
summary: This study aims to evaluate mid- and long-term outcomes after Thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR) with custom-made devices.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Thoracic Aortic Disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Urgent/Emergent treatment
sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS
